We had introduced Fourth Partner Energy as a potential client for Dice. Dice had conversations with Sudhakar Kada who is the CFO. They are the second largest Renewable Energy Solutions Company in India, catering to Commercial & Industrial businesses. They process over 6-7k invoices per month and have 60 entities. Sudhakar gave a very positive reaction to Dice and is looking to replacing existing modules with Dice modules. On the spend management side, Fourth Partner Energy currently use Happay, however they saw the value in using Dice virtual wallet which does not require pre-loaded money freeing up a lot of working capital. Given the volume of invoices they process, they also saw value in Dice’s P2P functionality which reduces the total number of licenses thus reducing cost. Finally, Fourth Partner Energy also looked at shifting their travel partners once onboarded to Dice. Discussions are currently going on between Dice and Fourth Partner Energy for a potential commercial engagement.
